principles: DONE confirm should own safe prerequisite automation
real source changes must still force retest
drivers: BUG-4 persists when users manually merge main
story_sync_main already encodes the safe metadata --ours policy
DONE gate has enough context to retry after metadata-only sync

options.name: A: DONE confirm auto-runs story_sync_main when branch sync is the only failure
cons: DONE confirm becomes a slightly larger mutation path

options.name: B: keep separate story_sync_main only
cons: agents still need to remember an extra command and can loop on evidence after manual merge

options.name: C: always merge main before DONE checklist
cons: can mutate before seeing other gate failures and surprises dry-run expectations

chosen: A: DONE confirm auto-runs story_sync_main when branch sync is the only failure
rationale: 选择 A，因为它只在用户已 confirm DONE 且唯一阻塞是 branch sync 时自动执行，最大限度消除手动 merge 风险，同时保留源码冲突和 stale evidence 的硬阻塞。

preMortem.trigger: sync 后不重新计算 evidence freshness
preMortem.consequence: 未测试新 main 代码也 DONE
preMortem.mitigation: sync 后重建 DONE checklist；source changes 仍 stale

preMortem.trigger: 为了判断 sync 是否可行直接 merge
preMortem.mitigation: dry-run 只调用 story_sync_main dryRun 输出计划

preMortem.trigger: branch sync 与其它失败同时存在仍 auto-sync
preMortem.consequence: 用户以为 DONE 可以自动修所有问题
preMortem.mitigation: 仅当 branch sync 是唯一 fail 时 auto-sync
